thread:
Tess R: Handing LumenFlux to CS — closed today. Key deal context: Dedicated VPC (US), Okta SSO, nightly bulk embeddings from on-prem workers, saw intermittent 503s during parallel imports in POC. Estimated usage ~3.5M tokens/mo. Renewal Sep 2026 (6mo). Main contact: danielle@lumenflux.ai. Sales doc: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/lumenflux/deal>. Please pick up onboarding and triage. @Noah B can you lead?

Noah B: I can. Quick asks: do we have a sanitized import job + IdP metadata? Need to know whether imports come from their VPC or public egress. Danielle please share manifest and a short log snippet if possible.

Tess R: Danielle said IT will send IdP metadata by tomorrow and uploaded a sanitized manifest to the share. Imports run from their self-hosted workers inside their VPC. Contract notes: possible SLA credit clause if availability < target (see sec 4.1).

Noah B: Plan: 1) 30m kickoff + ops sync 2) ENG ticket to repro 503s 3) SUP ticket for monitoring & alerting 4) 1-pager ops guide for batch tuning.

SupportBot: Created task "lumenflux-kickoff" (ID ONB-9001). ENG ticket ENG-2211 and SUP ticket SUP-670 created.

Priya M: Ill take ENG-2211. Initial hypothesis: ingress throttling or connection pooling exhaustion. Need sample concurrency, batch size, and whether they stream responses.

Noah B: Owners: CS lead — Noah B; ENG — Priya M; Support — Tess R; Enablement — Noah B. Action items: - Noah: schedule kickoff (due 2026-04-03) - Priya: run repro & report (ETA 48h) - Tess: set up dashboards + runbook draft (ETA 72h) - Tess: follow up on IdP metadata if not received (EOD)

Priya M: ENG-2211 started. Will run a staged import in our staging env mimicking their manifest. If we hit limits, options: a) temporary ingress-burst window b) increase connection limits c) recommend sharded imports + backoff. ETA initial results: 48h.

Tess R: SUP-670 will add panels: 5xx rate, token-queue depth, connection lifetime, and tail latency. Drafting a small incident runbook for bulk-import failures.

Noah B: Sales flagged renewal risk 6/10 because reliability affects procurement. Ill add a 60-day checkpoint in CRM and capture enablement feedback after the first run.

Priya M: Quick smoke command Ill include in the ops guide: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"input\":\"x\"}' https://private.lumenflux.redwood/api/generate -o /dev/null`  will parameterize batch_size and concurrency.

Tess R: If ENG finds issues on our side, sales can discuss a short remediation credit. Closing for now; will reopen with kickoff notes.

Noah B: Thanks team :thumbsup: Ill post the calendar invite shortly and link the runbook.
